name: skills-azure-naming
description: Azure resource naming for coding agents: proposes a naming convention, implements it in Terraform with the LemurDaniel/naming provider or Microsoft's Azure/naming/azurerm module, and checks every name against Azure's rules before it is deployed.

plugins.name: azure-naming
plugins.description: Proposes and implements Azure resource names in Terraform. Asks which naming mechanism to use (LemurDaniel/naming provider, Azure/naming/azurerm or the repository's own), renders every name with Terraform instead of guessing it, and pins existing names so a migration renames nothing.
